mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE) reflects deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically suppresses consumer spending and corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 0.25% signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, which typically reduces the cost of capital and stimulates economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strengthening consumer demand, which typically supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS increase by at least 0.5% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) above 95 indicates a strengthening manufacturing sector, which typically boosts corporate profits and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO > 95 during an early recovery phase.

mechanism_narrative: A GDP level (GDPC1) below 11000 billion (2017 dollars) indicates a severe economic contraction, which typically suppresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 < 11000.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL below 215 indicates low inflation, which often precedes deflationary concerns and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL < 215.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payrolls (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a robust labor market, which typically supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% and UNRATE decreases by at least 0.1% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of near-zero federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%) and low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 215) signals an active monetary easing cycle, which typically reduces the cost of capital and stimulates economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.25 and CPIAUCSL < 215.
